name: [Job] Adventurer in another time and space

steps.name: [Job] Adventurer in another time and space

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is none other than strange data that has been flowing into the hyperspace network recently.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I clearly recognize that the data was generated by Adventurer, but there is also content that I know does not belong to Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Perhaps this is a trace of Adventurer, who has multiple worlds and multiple memories. It seems that various phenomena have appeared as the hyperspace network is shaken.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: If another Adventurer takes action, it will be recorded and Adventurer can check it. And if Adventurer does something, other Adventurer will be able to check it... .

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You might not understand it at first, but... , you will get used to it. From now on, all of Adventurer's records will proceed below the chapter you are currently in.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Unit of story... no see. I hope you will check it out in the future if new data is discovered.
